# BCGov Crow - v0.9.3

## Release type

Patch release improving .NET testing guidance for xUnit v2-to-v3 migration,
cancellation, property-based testing, and shared-database isolation.

## Summary

Crow now provides a dedicated, confirmation-gated xUnit v2-to-v3 migration
assessment and clearer guidance for xUnit v3 lifecycle behavior, cancellation,
test-result reporting, CsCheck seeds, and retained fixture parents in shared
databases.

## Highlights

- Adds a focused xUnit v2-to-v3 migration playbook that distinguishes
  mechanical migrations from high-cost framework customizations and requires
  confirmation before migration.
- Clarifies xUnit v3 async disposal, cancellation-token propagation,
  xUnit1051 scope, Microsoft Testing Platform execution, and TRX publishing.
- Separates CsCheck replay seeds from deterministic Bogus builder seeds.
- Documents safe retained-parent cleanup for shared DEV/TEST databases,
  including random retained-ID allocation, bounded collision retries, and
  explicitly checked fixed ranges when stable IDs are required.

## Changes

- Registered the xUnit migration reference module in the Crow testing skill.
- Updated unit and integration testing guidance and fixture cross-references.
- Added shared-database parent-retention and ownership guidance.
- Added property-based testing seed-policy guidance.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.9.3 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.9.3.zip --global --target copilot
```
